sources.name: Le Lien Loches

sources.name: Le Lien Bléré
sources.coursePolicy: three forward courses with identical offsets and actual first reverse 40-minute course; no stitching with second reverse 37-minute course

sources.name: Fil Rouge
sources.coursePolicy: ordinary public weekday courses in term time and annual Tuesday morning courses; not restricted school services. Untimed on-request stops are not assigned invented times. Future 2026-11-02 timetable kept separately.

sources.name: Ogalo ZI Clos Bonnet–Chacé
sources.coursePolicy: two weekday departures per direction, whole actual 28- and 34-minute representative courses
